exceptions.rationale: IF-042/044/054 review: one REST surface covering router assembly, AppState, CORS, API-key auth (constant-time), process-wide run admission, and the ad-hoc inline-flow policy; extract admission and auth into modules before adding another cross-cutting middleware concern.
IF-028 review: one feature-gated store-construction boundary plus inline configuration tests; split when another backend concern is added.
IF-028 review: one task lifecycle spanning retries, deadlines, cancellation, and output publication; split before adding another lifecycle phase.

IF-046/052 review: one execution-plan validator and recovery-DAG builder covering dependency, cycle, on_error, retry-count, timeout, and route validation; split validation from graph construction before adding another planning phase.

IF-028/035 review: one Lua flow-builder registration surface (handler bytecode is now signed at dump time); nested closure complexity makes the next independent API group a mandatory extraction point.

IF-028/036 review: four closely related S3 object operations share one client and payload contract, plus a content-length size pre-flight on get_object; split when a fifth operation or new helper responsibility appears.
IF-049 review: the read/write/copy/move/delete file node family sharing size-cap and bounded-read enforcement; split by operation before adding another filesystem node.
IF-028 review: one framed JSON-RPC stdio transport, worker, and shutdown lifecycle; extract before adding another transport protocol concern.
IF-028 review: one bounded legacy-event migration state machine; splitting its ordered protocol would obscure progress and failure invariants.
IF-028 review: one EventStore implementation covering publish, list, decode, and delete transaction boundaries; split when another persistence responsibility appears.
IF-028 review: one primary/summary revision and digest codec with inline format tests; extract tests or a distinct format before adding codec behavior.
IF-028 review: one secure no-follow and durable-directory abstraction; split by responsibility before adding another filesystem operation family.
IF-028 review: one Redis CAS and snapshot mutation boundary sharing retry and script invariants; split before introducing another mutation protocol.
IF-028 review: one ordered catalog paging and repair boundary with inline ordering tests; extract tests or repair logic before adding listing behavior.

IF-051/052 review: the Redis StateStore trait surface delegating to CAS/catalog/listing/maintenance submodules, plus prune and first-terminal timestamp semantics; extract when another delegated concern appears.
IF-028 review: one generation-and-lease catalog rebuild state machine with inline tests; split before adding another recovery phase.
IF-028 review: one fail-closed secret collection and redaction boundary with substantial inline security tests; extract tests before adding another redaction strategy.
